items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 你好，我是科洛列夫茨基剧团首席女高音沃雅妮莎，如你所见…喔，我的意思是看我耳朵，看着就不寻常吧，因为我是一名「水妖」，不过这个身份不重要，你只需要记住，在整个科洛列夫茨基剧团里，我唱歌最好听就行。
items.text_en: Hello, I'm Vodyanitsa, the Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe. As you can see... Well, I mean, look at my ears. Pretty unusual, right? That's because I'm a "Water Imp." But that's neither here nor there. All you need to know is that I'm the best singer in the entire Korolevskiy Troupe.

items.title: 闲聊·听力
items.text: …嗯？你小声点，我好像又听见有人在说悄悄话，嘻嘻嘻，让我仔细听听看…
items.text_en: ...Hmm? Keep it down, I think I hear someone whispering again... Hehehe, lemme see if I can make out what they're saying...

items.title: 闲聊·练习
items.text: 反正闲着没事，在这里练习一下吧，算了，好像又会扰民，或者扰动物呢…
items.text_en: Well, if there's nothing else going on, I might as well do some rehearsing... Uh, no, forget it. I don't wanna disturb the locals again. Or the animals...

items.title: 闲聊·休闲方式
items.text: 呼…又在陆地上待了这么久，皮肤都干干的，还是快点回水下休息一下吧。
items.text_en: Whew... I've been on dry land for too long — my skin's getting dry. I'm in serious need of some underwater time.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 嗯，是个好天气，很适合躺在水底休息。
items.text_en: Ah, what a lovely day. Perfect for some underwater relaxation.

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 就停了？没劲…
items.text_en: Aw, where'd the rain go? What a downer...

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 白茫茫一片，哼，够干净的。
items.text_en: A vast expanse of white. Hmph, if nothing else, it's a clean aesthetic.

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: 好热，好干…想回水里去——
items.text_en: Ugh, it's so hot and dry... Get me back to the water...

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早上好，我刚好也开完嗓了，你听见了？嗯，那也正常，毕竟我的歌声很有穿透力嘛。
items.text_en: Good morning. I just finished my vocal warm-ups. Did you hear me? Yeah, I'm not surprised. My singing voice really carries.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 行了，吃午饭去吧，忙了一上午，我喉咙都要裂开了，等会去叫奥黛塔，我们简单吃一点。
items.text_en: Alright, time for some lunch. My poor voice is so tired after the morning I've had. I'll go get Odette, then we can grab a quick bite.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 呼啊，一天终于结束了。等会再去湖里泡泡吧，你来吗？怕什么，我又不是那种会拖人溺水的水妖，但如果你想试试，倒也不是不行。
items.text_en: Whew, the day is finally over. I'm gonna take a dip in the lake in a bit, you wanna join me? ...Huh? What are you so scared of? Pssh, no, I don't drag people underwater and try to drown them! I'm not THAT kind of Water Imp! But I can do that if you want!

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 晚安喽。早点睡吧，明天早上我还要按时开嗓呢，当然，如果你有需要，我也可以换首歌。
items.text_en: Nighty-night~ You should get to bed — I'll be getting up pretty early tomorrow to do my vocal warm-ups. Of course, if you have any song requests, I'm more than happy to oblige.

items.title: 关于沃雅妮莎自己·歌声的魅力
items.text: 很遗憾，我的歌声没什么能引人发狂的特别魔力，大家之所以愿意听我唱歌，只是单纯的因为我唱得好听而已。啊，但说到这个，我有一个关于矮灵的笑话，噗…呃，算了算了，不讲不讲，不然奥黛塔又要瞪我了。
items.text_en: Unfortunately, my voice doesn't cast any kind of magic spell on people that drives them crazy. People listen to me purely because I sing well. ...Ooh, although on that note, I actually have a joke about the Domovoy, hehehe... Ahem, never mind, forget I said that. Odette will start glaring at me again if I tell it.

items.title: 关于沃雅妮莎自己·审视
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启无论是不是演员，如果一个人想要被人们「看见」，那他就必须要接受人们的「审视」。这世上没有只占便宜，不付出代价的好事，就算有…呵，那也只是因为命运把价格标在了暗处。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Whether you're a performer or not, if you truly want to be seen by other people, you have to accept the scrutiny that comes with it. Nothing worth having in this world comes without a price. And if it ever seems like you got something for free... Heh, that just means that fate has secretly decided the price for you.

items.title: 关于我们·鱼尾巴
items.text: 为了方便在陆地上走路，我就把鱼尾巴变成双腿了，代价？没什么代价啊。哼，我作为一个水妖都离开水了，这代价已经足够大了，我还能付出什么，从此之后不能喝纯净水，只能喝果汁或者枫达吗？
items.text_en: I turned my fish tail into two legs to make walking on land easier. ...What price did I pay? None! Hmph, for us Water Imps, leaving the water behind is a big enough price to pay already. What else do you wanna take away from me, the right to drink fresh water? I suppose you'd make me subsist entirely on fruit juice or Fonta, wouldn't you?

items.title: 关于我们·郊游日
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启不过嘛，总是待在至冬也不行，我有时候也会顺着水源四处溯游，去看看其他地方的歌手是如何歌唱的。现在我已经去过了璃月，枫丹，稻妻，须弥…啊？有没有被人发现，有啊，嘻嘻，所以世界各地都流传着所谓「鲛人」、「人鱼」和「泉客」的传说啊。但我对纳塔的印象…呃，好热，然后还是好热。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Still, I can't just stay in Snezhnaya all the time. Sometimes, I'll follow the waterways and swim around the world to hear what singers in other places sound like. I've been to Liyue, Fontaine, Inazuma, Sumeru... Huh? Has anyone ever noticed me? Hehe, of course. That's why there's legends about merfolk, mermaids, sirens, and so on all over the world. Natlan was something else, though... That place is hot. With a capital H, O, T.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启这个小玩意？很好看，当个挂饰挺不错的，但平时唱歌也用不上它，至于「被神明注视」…呵，比起这个，我更愿意被观众们注视。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, this old thing? Yeah, it's pretty. Makes a nice piece of jewelry, I guess. But as a singer, I don't have much use for it most of the time. And as for "the gaze of the gods"... Hmph, I'm more interested in the gaze of my audience.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 枫丹的水质真好啊，之前我去枫丹看演出的时候，忍不住钻进水底待了好久，还不由自主地咕嘟咕嘟喝了好多水，可能是我弄出的动静太大了吧，让一个在岸边训练的特巡队队员注意到了，她还以为我溺水了呢，大呼小叫地就冲过来想要把我救上岸，至于我嘛…当然是一甩尾巴，飞快地窜走喽，嘻嘻嘻，然后我在远处看着她一边踩水，一边茫然地四处张望，还挺好玩的。直到看着她安全回到岸边，我才回去水底继续咕嘟咕嘟喝水，真的很好喝，下次一起去喝点？
items.text_en: The water quality in Fontaine is amazing! Last time I traveled to Fontaine to watch a show, I couldn't resist diving underwater. I stayed there for ages, and gulped down loads of water. But I guess I must have made too much of a splash, because I caught the attention of someone from the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol who was training on the shore. She thought I was drowning... She came rushing to the rescue, yelling at the top of her lungs. But, uh... I just flicked my tail and whoosed away, hehehe. Then watched from a distance while she treaded water and looked around in confusion. It was pretty hilarious. Anyway, I waited until she was safely back on shore before I went underwater again to carry on gulping away. It really is delicious, you know. You should join me next time.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 你知道「霜鳍鲸」吗？它们会用常人听不懂——甚至听不见——的「鲸歌」互相交流，但我们「水妖」能听懂它们的歌声，甚至还能学会呢。我就认识一位脾气特别好的霜鳍鲸，它叫希托娃，我之前去世界各地旅游的时候，都是它带着我赶路的，有机会的话，我把它介绍给你认识，它肯定会答应载着我们出去玩的。
items.text_en: Do you know about Frostfin Whales? They communicate using "whale songs," which most people can't even hear, let alone understand. But we Water Imps have no trouble understanding them, and we can even learn the language. I've actually gotten to know a Frostfin Whale named Hitova — real good-natured. Back when I was traveling all over, I hitched a ride off of her. I'll have to introduce you if I ever get the chance. I'm sure she'd be happy to take us both out for a ride.

items.title: 关于奥黛塔
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启每次奥黛塔去前台彩排的时候，我都会在后台仔细聆听她的舞步声。落下，跳起，旋转，再落下…干净利落，节奏规整，即使只是听声音，都能知道这绝对是一场完美的舞蹈演出…为什么我不去前台看？因为我要躲在后台吓她一跳啊。虽然每次都没吓到，但吓还是要继续吓的，不然我不是白躲了？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Whenever Odette is rehearsing, I listen along intently to her dance steps from backstage. She lands, then jumps, spins in the air, then lands again... Every motion is cleanly executed with impeccable timing. Just by listening, I can tell her dancing is flawless... Hm, why don't I go out front to watch? Hehe, because I wanna hide backstage and jump out at her afterwards! Sure, I haven't managed to scare her yet, but I have to keep trying. Otherwise, all that time I've spent hiding backstage would've been for nothing!

items.title: 关于米提亚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启希望这位聪明的先生不要在剧院的观众席上继续解题了，我们剧院不是什么超级自习室，也不是逃避工作的避难所，请认真地享受演出。不然我就…呼，算了，我也不能做什么，他确实很遵守剧院的观演礼仪。哼，下次我要挑一首动静大点的曲子，我看他还能不能顺利地解题。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I wish that Mr. Smarty Pants would stop trying to make scientific breakthroughs while he's watching the show. The theater is not a glorified study hall, and it's certainly not a refugee camp for escaped office workers. He'd better start taking our performances seriously... or I'll be forced to... *sigh* What am I saying — there's nothing I can do about it, especially since he technically does abide by theater etiquette... Hmph, next time I see him in the audience, I'll have to perform one of my louder pieces. Let's see how well he can concentrate on his work then.

items.title: 关于阿罗夏
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我一直在想，阿罗夏的小狗们能听懂我唱的歌吗？应该听不懂吧，毕竟我们也听不懂小狗们的歌，甚至都不知道它们会不会唱歌…不过，我唱的摇篮曲确实对小狗们很有用，每次都是只唱了一个开头，小狗们就睡成一片。唉，也不知道这算我唱得好还是不好啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've always wondered if Alyosha's puppies can understand my songs. I'm guessing probably not, since we can't understand puppy songs either. Matter of fact, I don't even know if they can sing at all... But my lullabies work like a dream on them. I'll barely make it through the opening verse before they're all out like a light. ...Hmm, not sure what that says about my singing, though... Is that good or bad?

items.title: 关于薇斯纳
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启多亏了薇斯纳小姐，那些倒卖剧院门票的票贩子们才不敢太嚣张。过段时间，薇斯纳小姐还打算邀请我开一场有关于预防票务诈骗的小型座谈会呢，在结束的时候，我还要唱一首歌作为闭幕。可我知道的歌里，也没有一首是能用来讽刺诈骗的啊，等等，战争里的战术欺骗，应该也能算是诈骗吧…？不、不然…来一首战争史诗…？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Thanks to Miss Vesna, those theater ticket scalpers know not to push their luck. She said she's planning to invite me to host a small conference on ticket scam prevention soon, and I'm supposed to be singing a song at the end to wrap things up. The thing is, out of all the songs I know, I don't think there's a single one for satirizing scam artists. ...Wait, tactical deception in war should count as a scam, right...? Ummm... maybe I could sing a war epic...?

items.title: 关于达妮卡
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我和达妮卡小姐虽然不算很熟，但也听说过她的威名。达妮卡小姐过得真辛苦啊，一边要帮女皇陛下分忧，一边还要看住薇斯纳小姐…咳，我什么都没说，没说。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I'm not personally very familiar with Miss Danica, though of course, her reputation precedes her. She must have had it tough, answering to the Tsaritsa on one hand while having to deal with Miss Vesna on the other... Ahem, but uh, you didn't hear that. At least, not from me.

items.title: 关于女皇陛下
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情如果女皇陛下来剧院观赏演出。那么我会为她演唱水妖们的「老歌」的。有多老？嗯…虽然还没老到只有女皇陛下听过的地步，但也足够吹起一阵小小的时光遗尘了，希望大家别被这阵扬起的尘沙迷住眼睛而流泪啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"If Her Majesty the Tsaritsa comes to see a show at the theater, I'll break out the old songs of the Water Imps for her. ...How old? Well... Not so old that only the Tsaritsa has heard them before, but definitely old enough that you can hear the dust coming off when you start singing them. I just hope it doesn't get in people's eyes. Wouldn't want to make everyone cry.

items.title: 关于哥伦比娅
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情那位哥伦比娅小姐已经不再是执行官了？可惜，我一直很喜欢她的嗓音，她哼唱的曲子就像是月光一样，柔美、轻盈又冰冷，虽然近在眼前，却又触不可及。呵，希望她能找到一个好去处，还有一群能听懂她歌声的朋友。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"Is Miss Columbina no longer a Harbinger? Huh, shame. I always thought she had a great singing voice. Her songs were like the moonlight itself: so soft and gentle, yet somehow icy cold. So present and vivid, yet so impossibly out of reach... Heh, I only hope she finds somewhere she can belong, with good friends who understand her songs.

items.title: 关于达达利亚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情达达利亚先生经常带着家里人来剧院里观看演出，不过，虽然执行官们可以免费入场，但他的家人们按照规定还是要如常购票的，好在，达达利亚先生总是能为自己的家人顺利弄到票。噢，冬妮娅你应该已经知道了吧，她也很喜欢演出，说不定等她长大之后，真的会加入我们剧院呢。到时候，达达利亚先生来剧院的次数恐怕又要增多了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"Mr. Tartaglia often brings his family to the theater. Harbingers get free admission, although family members have to buy tickets like everyone else. Fortunately, he always manages to secure tickets for his family. Oh, right — you know Tonia, don't you? She's a huge theater fan. She might even join us when she grows up. If that happens, I guess Mr. Tartaglia will have to get used to visiting the theater even more often.

items.title: 关于阿蕾奇诺
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启阿蕾奇诺女士有时候会带几个孩子来看演出，其中有一个孩子还有猫耳，我记得是叫琳妮特来着？她和那个叫林尼的孩子都很擅长魔术表演，有一次年终演出时，他们还在我们剧院的舞台上展示过魔术呢。不过，每次演出「山与雀」的时候，阿蕾奇诺女士几乎都是独自前来的…或许，她希望独自欣赏那场演出吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Lady Arlecchino sometimes brings a few children to watch a show at the theater. One of them has these cat ears — Lynette, I think her name was? Yeah, that's right — she and the boy, Lyney, are both excellent magicians. They actually performed a magic show here on the stage one time during an end-of-year performance. The only time Lady Arlecchino tends to come without the children is to watch "The Mountain Sparrow"... I suppose she prefers to enjoy that show alone.

items.title: 关于桑多涅
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启桑多涅小姐来看演出的时候，总是急匆匆的。有时候她咬着牙，眼角抽搐，有时候她面无表情，手里的稿纸却已经揉成了一团，看着好像是被人强行「请」来看演出的。我不想猜测到底是谁能「请」得动她，但…呵，至少每次演出结束时，她的表情都缓和了不少，看来是没白来。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Miss Sandrone always seems to be in a hurry whenever she comes to see a show. Sometimes she grits her teeth, sometimes her eyes twitch... Other times, her face is completely blank, but she's crumpled some scrap paper into a ball. If I didn't know better, I'd say someone was forcing her to come against her will... But far be it from me to speculate who has the power to force her into anything. Still... Heh, she always seems a little more relaxed by the end of the show. So at least she's not completely wasting her time.

items.title: 关于「队长」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启你说那位「队长」大人么？他…老实说，我并没有和他长时间地聊过天，最多只是演出散场时偶遇，简短地聊上几句。但我能感觉到，他是一个很严肃、正直的人。即使是在观众席的座位上，他也坐得十分笔直，就像是旗杆，或者是石柱，感觉无论多恐怖的风暴也无法将他折断或掀翻。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The captain? Oh, you mean THE Captain? Well... to be honest, I've never really had a proper conversation with him. I mean, we've exchanged a few brief words on occasion when we've bumped into each other after a show, but that's about it. Still, I can tell that he's a very serious and upstanding sort of person. Even in the audience stalls, he sits there completely straight, like a flagstaff or a pillar. I get the sense that nothing could ever faze him, let alone break him, not even the fiercest storm.

items.title: 想要了解沃雅妮莎·其一
items.text: 有什么好奇的问题，问呗。不过你问一个问题，我也要问你一个，这才公平。没关系，我不会问那种很难回答的问题，只会问…那些我暂时没打听到的问题。
items.text_en: So, you got some burning questions, huh? Well, ask away — but for every question you ask me, I get to ask you one, too. It's only fair. Don't worry, I won't ask any difficult questions. Just, uh... Y'know, the things I haven't found the answers to anywhere else.

items.title: 想要了解沃雅妮莎·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启虽然很抱歉打破了你的幻想，但至冬的「水妖」可不是传说中那种，会用歌声引诱水手发狂，或者是付出了巨大的代价才走上陆地，只要违反誓言就会变成泡沫的神奇物种，我们只是普通地生活在至冬，和所有人一样，仅此而已。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Sorry to burst your bubble, but we Snezhnayan Water Imps aren't some mythical creatures who drive sailors mad with our alluring songs, or pay some enormous price to walk on land, only to turn into sea foam if we break our vows. Nope, we're just ordinary people living ordinary lives, like everyone else in Snezhnaya.

items.title: 想要了解沃雅妮莎·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情自从那件事之后，水妖们几乎全部离开了至冬堡。我亲爱的兄弟姐妹们也邀请过我离开，但我拒绝了他们。如果至冬的各位市民突然听不见水妖的歌声，肯定会很难过，如果水妖的歌声被至冬遗忘，那我和其他的水妖们也会很难过。为了两边都不难过，我就留下来，继续唱歌了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"Since that incident, almost all the Water Imps have left Snezhnograd. My dear brothers and sisters invited me to leave with them, but I turned them down. I'm sure the citizens of Snezhnaya would be saddened if the day ever came that they could no longer hear our songs. And if Snezhnaya forgot our songs, the other Water Imps and I would be sad, too. That's why I stayed behind to keep singing. To prevent sadness all around.

items.title: 想要了解沃雅妮莎·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启…时过境迁，如今的至冬已经大变样了，我的歌声，也不得不承载更多的东西，变得越来越复杂，沉重，不由自主…我不喜欢这样，所以我给自己定了一个规矩，每当我想回家的时候，就在至冬找十个人，看他们是不是真心喜欢我的歌声，如果十个人里哪怕有一个人是真心喜欢我的歌，那我就会留下，如果这样的人十不存一，那我就会回到我兄弟姐妹们的身边。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5...Times have changed. Snezhnaya is a completely different place today. Inevitably, it's changed the way I relate to my singing, too. As time goes by, it's like the songs become... heavier, more layered and complex than ever, and I can't help but feel... Anyway, I don't like being like that, so I made a simple rule for myself: Whenever I feel like just going home, I find ten people in Snezhnaya and see if they like my singing. If even one out of ten genuinely likes my songs, I will stay. But if not even one person in ten cares, I'll return to my brothers and sisters.

items.title: 想要了解沃雅妮莎·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启呵，但不知道是幸运还是不幸，迄今为止，我总是能在那「十个人」里找到真心愿意听我唱歌的人，他们之中有人刚刚戴上了帽子，有人正昂首挺胸奋力拼搏，有人正坦然地走完人生的最后一程…即使是为了这些观众，我也会和那些萦绕在剧院之中的兄弟姐妹们继续唱下去。怎么样，你喜欢我的歌么？好好回答喔，水妖的听力可是很灵敏的，如果你撒谎，我就能听见你乱七八糟的心跳了，我来倒计时，三，二…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Heh, I don't know whether to call it good or bad luck, but every time I've sought out ten people to get their verdict, I've always found at least one who is genuinely willing to listen to my singing. Some were just starting out, others were deep in the trenches of the most heroic struggle of their lives, and some were calmly preparing for the final leg of their life's journey... Even if that were the entire audience, I and any of my kin who linger still in the theater would continue to sing for them. So, what about you? Do you enjoy my singing? Hehe. Be careful how you answer — we Water Imps have exceptionally good hearing. I'll know whether you're lying from your heartbeat alone. Ready? I'll count you in: Three, two...

items.title: 沃雅妮莎的爱好
items.text: 每当我心情好——或者特别不好——的时候，我都会跳进水里，闭上眼睛，让水流带着我四处漂流。我一边漂流，一边听着波浪为我带来的各种声音，小鱼们聚在一起，鳞片沙沙摩擦；巨鲸低沉地长吟，呼唤着遥远的同伴；水底的气泡浮起又破灭…偶尔漂流到城边，还能听见渔民喊着号子撒下渔网；孩子们欢笑着跃入水中；准备远航或已然归港的船吱呀作响…这样子聆听世界之声的感觉，可是很奇妙的，你想试试吗？下次带你一起去呗。
items.text_en: Whenever I'm in a good mood — or a really bad mood — I dive into the water, close my eyes, and let the current carry me around. As I drift along, I listen to all the sounds carried on the waves: Little fishies gathering together, their scales brushing against one another... giant whales singing deep, drawn-out songs as they call out to their partners far away... bubbles rising up from the deep, then bursting... Occasionally, when I drift by a city, I'll even hear the fishermen chanting as they cast their nets, children laughing as they leap into the water, and ships creaking as they prepare for a long voyage or return to port... Listening to the sounds of the world like this is truly magical. Do you want to try it? If so, I'll take you with me next time.

items.title: 沃雅妮莎的烦恼
items.text: 我不喜欢被赋予太多意义的声音，歌声就只是歌声，就好像波浪带回的信音，枯叶凋落在地的脆响，或者是奔跑的脚步声…声音背负的东西越多，就越难被理解，也就越难听。
items.text_en: I don't like sounds laden with too much meaning. Singing is just another sound, like the news carried by the waves, the crisp sound of falling leaves, or the pitter-patter of running footsteps... The greater a sound's burden, the harder it is to understand, and the more unpleasant it is to my ear.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 甜的就行，最好要冰冰凉凉，还带着点甜汤…啊，这么一说，不就是冰淇淋嘛。
items.text_en: Mm... Anything sweet, really. Although, preferably nice and cold, with just a dash of syrup, and... Huh, now that I say it out loud, I guess I'm just describing ice cream.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 毫无水分的东西，我实在咽不下去，如果强行吞咽的话，我会有一种自己的喉咙都被划破的错觉。
items.text_en: If there's no moisture in it whatsoever, I just cannot handle it. I mean, I can physically force myself to swallow it, sure, but my throat will feel like it's being torn to shreds on the way down.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 很好吃喔，怎么，上次我说了自己喜欢的口味，你就记住了？记性还不错啊，下次我也给你做点合你口味的食物吧。你没说过自己喜欢的口味？没关系，我已经知道了，我有自己的方法打听。
items.text_en: Ooh, this is delicious! I guess you remembered what I told you about my favorite foods, huh? You have a pretty good memory. Next time, it's my turn to make some food tailored to your tastes. ...Yeah, I know you've never explicitly told me before, but don't worry — I already know. I have my ways of finding these things out.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 谢谢。哦对了，上次我和你说过我最喜欢吃的东西，你还记得么？记得啊，嗯…记性不错，那下次我再说点难记的吧，嘻嘻嘻。
items.text_en: Thanks. Oh, by the way, do you still remember my favorite food? I told you last time. You do? Hmm... Guess you've got a pretty good memory. I'll have to give you something tougher to remember next time, hehehe.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: …下次，我还是清楚地把我喜欢的口味告诉你吧。或者，我直接教你做点好吃的。
items.text_en: ...Maybe next time, I should be clear about my food preferences in advance. Or maybe I can teach you how to make something really delicious.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐！礼物我就放在那边了，等会你自己拆开来看看吧，大概就是一些小饰品和玩具之类的…哎呀，这个不重要，你现在应该没什么事要忙吧？走走走，去我的「回音室」，我前几天托人从纳塔采购了一台「热舞乐台」，还有其他很多奇奇怪怪但很好玩的乐器，我正准备办一场整个至冬最棒的音乐聚会，猜猜谁第一个被邀请？没错，就是你，来吧，今天我们唱一个通宵！
items.text_en: Happy Birthday! I've set aside your gift. You can open it later. It's just some small trinkets, toys, and whatnot... Eh, but that's not the important part. You're free now, aren't you? In that case, come with me! We're going to my echo chamber. I got someone to buy me a Dance-Off Stage from Natlan a few days ago, along with a whole bunch of weird and wonderful instruments. I'm working on the best music event Snezhnaya's ever seen, and guess who's the first person to receive an invitation? That's right, it's you! Come on, let's sing the night away!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启咳咳，咳——声音不错。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Ahem, ahem... Alright. Sounding good.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启好像可以唱得更高了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2I think I just reached a new high note.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启喉咙的状态更好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Ah, my voice is feeling stronger than ever.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启嗯！该彻夜高歌了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Whoo! Time to sing the whole night through!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 仔细聆听。
items.text_en: Listen closely.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 先开开嗓吧。
items.text_en: Start with a warm up.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 登台时刻到了。
items.text_en: Taking the stage.

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 这样才痛快——
items.text_en: This is more like it...

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 嘻，瞧我的鱼尾巴。
items.text_en: Heehee, look at my fish tail!

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 呼啊！
items.text_en: Woo! Hahahaha!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 这首，是遗尘的挽歌。
items.text_en: An elegy to mortality.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 这首，是旧日的颂曲。
items.text_en: An ode to eras past.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 所有人，一起高歌吧！
items.text_en: Everyone, lift your voices!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 哎呀！这么多亮闪闪的宝贝，快收起来。
items.text_en: Wow! Look at all these shiny treasures! Quick, grab 'em!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 看着还行，拿着玩玩倒也不错。
items.text_en: This looks alright, I guess. Could be fun to play around with.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 里面装着这些？宝箱？好吧…
items.text_en: Is that it? Huh. So much for "treasure" chest...

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 呵呵…呵…
items.text_en: Hehe... Heh...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 我玩够了。
items.text_en: I'm done playing.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: …真是够蠢的。
items.text_en: ...Oh, you'll regret that.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 喂！干什么呢？！
items.text_en: Hey! What are you doing!?

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 过来！别乱跑了！
items.text_en: Get over here! Stop messing around!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 呵…你们来了…
items.text_en: You're all here...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 波涛啊…带我…归乡…
items.text_en: Waves... carry me home...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 终曲…？也不错…
items.text_en: A high note... to end on...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 脚滑了…
items.text_en: I slipped...

items.title: 普通受击·其二
items.text: 哼！还没完呢…！
items.text_en: Hmph! I'm not done yet...!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 有本事去水里！
items.text_en: Face me in the water if you're so tough!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 陆地真不方便…！
items.text_en: I'm not built for dry land...!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 我听见你叫我了。
items.text_en: My ears are burning.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 来了，有什么事？
items.text_en: Here I am. What's up?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 咳…嗯，嗓子状态不错。
items.text_en: *clear throat* Mm, my vocal cords are all warmed up.
